operators.name: conv_transpose1d_no_bias
semantics: Implements F.conv_transpose1d(x, weight, bias=None, stride=stride, padding=padding, output_padding=output_padding) using cuDNN.
No bias tensor is passed; bias is None.
Input x is expected to be on CUDA; weight is on CUDA.
Output length = (length - 1) * stride - 2 * padding + kernel_size + output_padding.
The result dtype and device match input x.

operators.name: add_channel_bias_round
semantics: Adds bias.view(1, -1, 1) to x (broadcasting along batch and length dims) and applies torch.round to the result.
The addition is performed element-wise: out[b,c,l] = round(x[b,c,l] + bias[c]).
The output has the same shape as x.
The operation is performed on CUDA tensors.

reference_steps.source: x = F.conv_transpose1d(x, self.conv_transpose.weight, bias=None, stride=self.conv_transpose.stride, padding=self.conv_transpose.padding, output_padding=self.conv_transpose.output_padding)
semantics: Computes 1D transposed convolution without bias using cuDNN.
Input: x shape [128, 4, 8192], weight shape [4, 8, 3], stride=2, padding=1, output_padding=1.
Adds first parameter of shape [8] broadcast along batch and length dims.
Adds second parameter of shape [8] broadcast along batch and length dims.
Rounds each element of x to nearest integer.
